upstream_title: Analysis Data Model Implementation Guide v1.3
capture_method: official CDISC release-page inspection; normalized metadata and paraphrased evidence only

locators.claim: ADaMIG 1.3 specifies analysis dataset structures, variables and naming conventions.
The guide describes ADSL and the Basic Data Structure; OCCDS is covered by a separate implementation guide.
ADaM implementation must be interpreted together with the compatible model, conformance rules and applicable supplements.

rights_note: This repository stores only project-authored metadata and paraphrases; access to normative files may require CDISC credentials.
